title: Antarctica Is Freezing, Yet 1.3 Million Square Kilometers Vanished
hook: Antarctica froze, yet 1.3 million square kilometers of sea ice vanished.
closing: Less reflective ice leaves more heat in the ocean, affecting everyone beyond Antarctica.
question: Does this record change your climate view?

segments.say: Antarctic sea ice fell to 1.79 million square kilometers. The minimum broke below its long-term range.
Missing sea ice covered 1.3 million square kilometers. An abstract record became a continent-scale gap.
Sea ice reflects 60 percent of sunlight. Losing it lets the darker ocean absorb more heat.
